description.value: The study investigated neural correlates of numeric working-memory deficits and their associations with response inhibition in patients with obsessive-compulsive disorder compared with healthy controls, using fMRI during a four-level n-back task and behavioral stop-signal testing in a subsample.

spans.text: We investigated WM performance in a numeric n-back task with four WM load conditions during functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging (fMRI) in 51 patients with OCD and 49 healthy control participants who were matched for age, sex, and education. Additionally, a stop signal task was performed outside the MRI scanner in a subsample.

description.value: Between-group, cross-sectional observational study with OCD patients and matched healthy controls; a subsample also completed a stop-signal task outside the MRI scanner.

N-back performance (defined as hitrate minus false alarm rate) and reaction time during correct responses were used as outcome scores for behavioral analyses of the n-back task.
